answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 58851 Country: India Title: Zakat & Tax Question: Is a tax payer eligible for zakah? Answer ID: 58851 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 301/301/SD=06/1436) According to Shariah, such a person is entitled to receive zakah who is not owner of nisab. If a person paying tax is sahib nisab i.e. he owns silver 612.360 or cash or business commodity equal to its value or extra goods then according to Shariah he is not entitled to receive zakah; otherwise he can receive zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
